55: And from the place that you came - Since you did not learn that we infer the law of a doubtful case of defilement only from the law of the sotah, go back and study what the sotah law is. What is a sotah who is defiled? She is in doubt according to the opinion of Rabbi Yehuda. This is the appropriate place to hide even a case of defilement in private domain - its status is doubtful. But in public domain, it is pure
